previous_statement: Uniform amplified homomorphism estimate. For gamma_n:=alpha_n Gamma_n mu_n=I_n tensor gamma, the four clauses of def-four-corner-merging-datum and the compressed-product estimate in def-compressed-corner imply, with one universal K_hom, that gamma_n preserves involution exactly, has unit defect at most K_hom e, and has multiplicative defect at most K_hom e||X||||Y||, simultaneously for every n.
new_statement: Uniform amplified homomorphism estimate. For gamma_n:=alpha_n Gamma_n mu_n=I_n tensor gamma, the four clauses of def-four-corner-merging-datum and the compressed-product estimate in def-compressed-corner imply, with one universal K_hom, that ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=K_hom e||X||, the unit defect is at most K_hom e, and the multiplicative defect is at most K_hom e||X||||Y||, simultaneously for every n.
